name: john
description: John - a Codex and Claude Code harness for building app-first, knowledge-dense apps from unstructured source material.

interface.shortDescription: Build knowledge-dense apps from source documents
interface.longDescription: John helps Codex run long app-first knowledge projects: parse and survey source documents, infer the ordinary-user app shape, write fixed intent/display/extraction JSON contracts, extract and rewrite the knowledge needed by that app, then build a standalone result.
